scope: Official catalog and exact LCDV2 firmware candidate acquisition; offline pinned-byte inspector; static binary handler analysis. No daemon/protocol/GUI update integration and no device access.

baseline.provenance: AppUpdater hash rechecked against prior firmware-identity checkpoint; original assembly hashes not rerun this slice.

catalog.mapping: AppUpdater.cs:370 GA II LCD -> GA2LCD; FirmwareUpdateUtils.cs:192-194 LCD/LCDV2 -> GA2LCD
catalog.ru_request: HTTP403 observed; no permanent availability conclusion

image.download: 39 HTTPS range requests; If-Match vendor MD5 ETag; exact Content-Range and length checks, reassembled MD5/size match. Initial full requests and resume timed out; partial files never accepted.

findings.inference: Dispatcher calls B callbacks from 0x862f8 and sends 512-byte response.
Collects total bytes from PN0, requires sequential later PN; PN0 resets accumulation. Retry semantics must not assume idempotence.

cmd11 returns copied input envelope; errors cmd2 with byte6 = 0x80 + local code. On full byte count validates offset/magic, persists staging file and compares readback; intermediate echo is not final persistence proof.

cmd10 payload01 checks upload state/staged file, copies and verifies final file, sets raw bytes11/12 to1, emits reply then resets. Error branches use cmd2/byte6 envelope. Persistent boot/recovery unresolved.
cmd134 returns identity/date in two PN roles using fixed build strings.

static_analysis.confidence: Static source-derived only, exact image SHA-256; inferred function roles and statuses are not hardware ACK qualification.

implementation.behavior: No filename trust, target constrained to researched VID/PID, exact size and full SHA-256 plus identity consistency. O_PATH pins a regular inode before read via /proc/self/fd; bounded read. Unknown rejected, always flash_ready=false. No network, HID, packet serialization or update call.

coverage: pathname replacement with FIFO symlink cannot redirect pinned inode read

result.error: This candidate is researched only for 0416:7395.
Unknown image SHA-256; no firmware recognized.

checks.rust_browser_native: NOT RUN: this slice changes only research Python tool/tests and documents; no application sources changed.
checks.hardware: NOT RUN; no HID or daemon started.

remaining: Hardware revision/model compatibility is not proved by catalog mapping, filename or identity token.
Generic image format/signature/target validation absent; inspector recognizes one exact candidate only.
Catalog MD5 is not a signature; pinned SHA256 records analyzed bytes.
ACK/error parser, exclusive update job, persistent boot/recovery model, identity-bound reconnect and version verification remain unimplemented.
No hardware flash/fault injection on the only AIO.
Mini is Plasma/GNOME integration, English default and Russian required; other environments/languages and extra effects stay deferred.
